finding: The latent64_model column contains a legacy model marker rather than the current checkpoint checksum. The current eligibility predicate therefore classifies rows with matching latent_256 as stale whenever latent64_model differs from the checkpoint revision.
impact: A bounded apply can repeatedly select already-populated latent64 rows unless marker compatibility or an explicit derived-artifact identity check is added.
requiredNextGate: Define legacy marker reconciliation and verify latent64 derivation before any further apply.
